subject: Urgent: token-lag affecting redwood-model-3a-v2 (FastBank) - escalation
messages:
From: Carl Hughes <carl.hughes@fastbank.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 05 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors starting 08/05 - redwood-model-3a-v2

Evelyn —

We started seeing a jump in timeouts and partial responses at ~08:45 PST this morning. Error rate climbed from ~0.3% to 2.8% for our verification workflow; users hit stalled completions and several automated checks timed out. Our engineering logs point at long tail token emission delays for redwood-model-3a-v2 (lots of small spikes at 1.8–3.4s/token in the tail). Attaching a short capture and our SLO dashboard.

Can you confirm whether this is an isolated degradation on your side or something we need to mitigate locally? This workflow is critical to our front-line verification and we're approaching the throughput threshold in our contract.

Files attached: slo-dashboard-20280805.png, heap-traces-fastbank-0805.zip

— Carl
Lead Platform Engineer
FastBank
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Aug 2028 09:37:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Production errors starting 08/05 - redwood-model-3a-v2

Forwarding Carl's note — fast signal from a strategic customer (FastBank, FB-9231). They see token-level tail latency spikes causing timeouts in verification flows. Cc'd Rishi for root-cause triage, Ben/Grace for rollback/traffic policy decisions.

Ask: can the infra/runtime team (Rishi) confirm whether latest runtime patch (3a-v2 -> kernel changes) rolled earlier today in us-west-2 and whether we have automatic fallback configured to 3a-v1? If root cause is kernel or quantization mismatch, we may need an immediate canary rollback.

Business constraints: FastBank is at a committed consumption tier and has MSLU SLA clauses that trigger credits if p95 > 350ms for more than 1 hour. If we need an exception window to perform a controlled rollback, we should document duration and mitigations.

I'll coordinate comms with the customer; if you need an explicit authorization from Sales/RevOps for an SLA carveout, flag it in your reply.

— Evelyn
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Aug 2028 09:52:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors starting 08/05 - redwood-model-3a-v2

Evelyn / team —

I ran an initial check against the rollout logs. We did a smallkernel substitution for 3a-v2 at 08:15 PST in us-west-2 to enable a new attention optimization (change-id: KNL-7132). Canary traffic showed no issues during the 30m window, but I see an uptick in long tail runtime stalls starting ~08:40 which correlates to longer sequences (customer verification sequences that exceed 1.2k tokens).

Immediate plan:
- Flip traffic for FastBank routing to the v1 runtime variant (3a-v1) for the production route (canary to 3a-v1, full shift if metrics stabilize). This will require a short config change and warmup period (~6–8 minutes).
- Keep the v2 nodes isolated and collect extended traces (I've attached the heap/dump request for the nodes handling FB traffic).
- If approved, propose a temporary SLA carveout window (internal docs + customer notice) from 08:50–10:30 to complete safe fallback and extended validation.

I recommend Ben or Grace authorize the carveout for duration and notify Sales to log an SLA ticket if we miss p95 targets longer than the window.

— Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 05 Aug 2028 10:03:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors starting 08/05 - redwood-model-3a-v2

Go ahead with the canary rollback for FastBank only (route-level shift). I authorize the temporary routing change to 3a-v1 for their production namespace. Please follow these constraints:

- Keep the traffic target limited to FastBank first; wait 10m for p95 and error-rate to settle before broader rollout.
- Grab perf-samples and the first 1k emitted tokens for our quality checks so Research can confirm output parity.
- Document the window and request a formal SLA carveout ticket from Sales (Evelyn, can you log it?) — we will not auto-grant credits until we have the timeline documented.

If the rollback stabilizes the customer, we'll schedule a deeper postmortem and a fix backlog item for the kernel subsidiarity.

— Ben
VP, Production Reliability
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Carl Hughes <carl.hughes@fastbank.com>, procurement@fastbank.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Aug 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors starting 08/05 - redwood-model-3a-v2

Carl — thank you for the quick signal and the attachments. We implemented a route-level canary rollback for your production namespace at 08:58 PST on 2028-08-05 to redirect calls to redwood-model-3a-v1 while we investigate the kernel change.

Current status (summary):
- Traffic shifted to 3a-v1 for FastBank only; p95 returned to baseline within the 10m observation window.
- We've captured extended runtime traces and token samples and attached a short impact summary (FastBank-impact-summary.pdf) to this thread.
- We are opening a formal SLA carveout window (08:50–10:30 PST on 2028-08-05) to perform the fallback and extended validation. Sales will log the ticket and follow up on any credit considerations per contract.

Next steps:
1) Rishi and team will continue trace collection; engineering will triage kernel change with Research.
2) We will share a postmortem with timeline and mitigation plan within 48 hours.
3) If FastBank prefers a written acknowledgement of the carveout and planned remediation timeline for procurement, let me know and I'll prepare a short statement.

Apologies for the disruption — we understand how sensitive this workflow is and will prioritize the follow-up.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: FastBank-impact-summary.pdf (3 pages), slo-dashboard-20280805.png, heap-traces-fastbank-0805.zip
